title.suggested: Siler recalls McCoole's pauper death and Allen's help

summary.suggested: The St. Louis Post-Dispatch reported referee George Siler's recollection that Mike McCoole died a pauper in New Orleans in the early 1880s and was saved from a pauper's grave by his old rival, Tom Allen.

metadata.notes: Masthead: Sunday Morning, St. Louis Post-Dispatch, November 28, 1897, page 33. Headline 'The Days of M'Coole'.

facts.fact: According to referee George Siler, Mike McCoole died a pauper in New Orleans and Allen saved him from a pauper's grave

notes: Needs a re-crop to capture the rest of the article. Siler says McCoole beat Allen for the world championship in 1870 and died 'early in the 80s'; both are secondhand recollections and the dates are doubtful.
